label: Sci-Fi Location
description: Speculative settings for science-fiction scenes. Tagged 'scifi' for genre-filtered templates.

items.name: megacity-canyon
items.text: The floor of a megacity canyon, sheer kilometer-high towers on both sides stitched together by skybridges and streams of aerial traffic.

items.name: orbital-ring-promenade
items.text: A curved promenade inside an orbital ring station, the planet's cloud-swirled surface filling the panoramic windows overhead.

items.name: hangar-bay
items.text: A cavernous starship hangar bay, service gantries and fuel lines surrounding landing pads under cold floodlights.

items.name: alien-desert
items.text: A desert plain under an alien sky with two moons, wind-carved rock arches glowing faintly with mineral veins.

items.name: neon-market
items.text: A crowded street market beneath layered holographic advertisements, steam and neon bleeding together over food stalls.

items.name: terraforming-frontier
items.text: The edge of a terraforming zone, atmosphere processors on the horizon, young green growth breaking through cracked red regolith.

items.name: derelict-generation-ship
items.text: The overgrown interior of a derelict generation ship, vines wrapping dormant machinery beneath a fractured artificial sky.

items.name: cryo-vault
items.text: A frost-rimmed cryogenic vault, rows of glowing stasis pods receding into darkness.

items.name: space-elevator-base
items.text: The colossal anchor complex of a space elevator, its ribbon rising through the clouds and out of sight.

items.name: underwater-dome-city
items.text: A transparent dome city on the ocean floor, bioluminescent life drifting past the pressure glass.

items.name: gas-giant-platform
items.text: A mining platform riding the upper cloud decks of a gas giant, endless amber storm bands wheeling below.

items.name: quantum-server-cathedral
items.text: A cathedral-scale server hall, crystalline compute pillars pulsing with slow light beneath vaulted cooling arrays.
